theorem evaluate_clock {ffi : Type} :
    (∀ (s1 : cml_state ffi) (env : sem_env) (e : List exp) (s2 : cml_state ffi)
      (r : result (List v) v),
      evaluate s1 env e = (s2, r) → s2.clock ≤ s1.clock) ∧
    (∀ (s1 : cml_state ffi) (env : sem_env) (val_ : v) (p : List (pat × exp)) (v' : v)
      (s2 : cml_state ffi) (r : result (List v) v),
      evaluate_match s1 env val_ p v' = (s2, r) → s2.clock ≤ s1.clock) ∧
    (∀ (s1 : cml_state ffi) (env : sem_env) (ds : List dec) (s2 : cml_state ffi)
      (r : result sem_env v),
      evaluate_decs s1 env ds = (s2, r) → s2.clock ≤ s1.clock)

theorems.name: TOKENS_eq_tokens_aux
theorems.statement:
theorem TOKENS_eq_tokens_aux (P : Char → Bool) (ls : mlstring) (ss : List Char)
    (n len : Nat) :
    n + len = (explode ls).length →
    (tokens_aux P ls ss n len).map explode =
    match ss with
    | h :: t =>
      if len ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ P (HOL4.EL n (explode ls)) then
        ((h :: t).reverse ++ (HOL4.TOKENS P (HOL4.DROP n (explode ls))).head!) ::
          (HOL4.TOKENS P (HOL4.DROP n (explode ls))).tail
      else if len ≠ 0 then
        (h :: t).reverse :: HOL4.TOKENS P (HOL4.DROP n (explode ls))
      else [(h :: t).reverse]
    | [] => HOL4.TOKENS P (HOL4.DROP n (explode ls))

        (nsLookup e1 id_ = none ∧ nsLookup e2 id_ = some val_ ∧

      (e1 : «namespace» m n v1) (e2 : «namespace» m n v2),

theorems.name: nsSub_nsAppend2

theorems.name: alist_rel_restr_thm
theorems.statement:
theorem alist_rel_restr_thm {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k] [LawfulBEq k] :
    ∀ (R : k → v1 → v2 → Prop) (e1 : List (k × v1)) (e2 : List (k × v2)) (keys : List k),
      alist_rel_restr R e1 e2 keys ↔
        ∀ (k_ : k), MEM k_ keys = true →
          ∃ (val1 : v1) (val2 : v2),
            ALOOKUP e1 k_ = some val1 ∧ ALOOKUP e2 k_ = some val2 ∧ R k_ val1 val2

theorems.name: alistSub_cong

theorem alistSub_cong {k v1 v2 : Type} [BEq k] [LawfulBEq k] :
    ∀ (l1 l1' : List (k × v1)) (l2 l2' : List (k × v2))
      (R R' : k → v1 → v2 → Prop),
      l1 = l1' ∧ l2 = l2' ∧
        (∀ (n_ : k) (x : v1) (y : v2),
          ALOOKUP l1' n_ = some x ∧ ALOOKUP l2' n_ = some y → R n_ x y = R' n_ x y) →
        (alistSub R l1 l2 ↔ alistSub R' l1' l2')

theorems.name: nsLookup_FOLDR_nsLift_some

theorems.name: do_app_cases
theorems.statement:
theorem do_app_cases {ffi : Type} :
    ∀ (s : List (store_v v)) (t : ffi_state ffi) (op_ : op) (vs : List v)
      (st' : List (store_v v) × ffi_state ffi) (r : result v v),
    do_app (s, t) op_ vs = some (st', r) ↔
    (              
      (∃ x1 x2 xs ys, op_ = .ListAppend ∧ vs = [x1, x2] ∧
        v_to_list x1 = some xs ∧ v_to_list x2 = some ys ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (list_to_v (xs ++ ys))) ∨
                 
      (∃ sh n w, op_ = .Shift .W8 sh n ∧ vs = [.Litv (.Word8 w)] ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.Word8 (shift8_lookup sh w n)))) ∨
                  
      (∃ sh n w, op_ = .Shift .W64 sh n ∧ vs = [.Litv (.Word64 w)] ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.Word64 (shift64_lookup sh w n)))) ∨
                 
      (∃ v1 v2 b, op_ = .Equality ∧ vs = [v1, v2] ∧
        do_eq v1 v2 = .Eq_val b ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (Boolv b)) ∨
                 
      (∃ b lnum val_ s', op_ = .Opassign ∧ vs = [.Loc b lnum, val_] ∧
        store_assign lnum (.Refv val_) s = some s' ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Conv none [])) ∨
              
      (∃ val_ s' n, op_ = .Opref ∧ vs = [val_] ∧
        store_alloc (.Refv val_) s = (s', n) ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Loc true n)) ∨
                
      (∃ b n val_, op_ = .Opderef ∧ vs = [.Loc b n] ∧
        store_lookup n s = some (.Refv val_) ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval val_) ∨
                 
      (∃ n w, op_ = .Aw8alloc ∧ vs = [.Litv (.IntLit n), .Litv (.Word8 w)] ∧
        n < 0 ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ n w s' lnum, op_ = .Aw8alloc ∧ vs = [.Litv (.IntLit n), .Litv (.Word8 w)] ∧
        ¬ n < 0 ∧
        store_alloc (.W8array (REPLICATE n.natAbs w)) s = (s', lnum) ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Loc true lnum)) ∨
               
      (∃ b lnum i ws, op_ = .Aw8sub ∧ vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        i < 0 ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ b lnum i ws, op_ = .Aw8sub ∧ vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ i.natAbs ≥ ws.length ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ b lnum i ws, op_ = .Aw8sub ∧ vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ ¬ i.natAbs ≥ ws.length ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.Word8 (EL i.natAbs ws)))) ∨
                      
      (∃ b lnum i ws, op_ = .Aw8sub_unsafe ∧ vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ ¬ i.natAbs ≥ ws.length ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.Word8 (EL i.natAbs ws)))) ∨
                  
      (∃ b n ws, op_ = .Aw8length ∧ vs = [.Loc b n] ∧
        store_lookup n s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.IntLit (Int.ofNat ws.length)))) ∨
                  
      (∃ b lnum i w ws, op_ = .Aw8update ∧
        vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i), .Litv (.Word8 w)] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        i < 0 ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ b lnum i w ws, op_ = .Aw8update ∧
        vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i), .Litv (.Word8 w)] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ i.natAbs ≥ ws.length ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ b lnum i w ws s', op_ = .Aw8update ∧
        vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i), .Litv (.Word8 w)] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ ¬ i.natAbs ≥ ws.length ∧
        store_assign lnum (.W8array (LUPDATE w i.natAbs ws)) s = some s' ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Conv none [])) ∨
                         
      (∃ b lnum i w ws s', op_ = .Aw8update_unsafe ∧
        vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i), .Litv (.Word8 w)] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ ¬ i.natAbs ≥ ws.length ∧
        store_assign lnum (.W8array (LUPDATE w i.natAbs ws)) s = some s' ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Conv none [])) ∨
                   
      (∃ strng off len, op_ = .CopyStrStr ∧
        vs = [.Litv (.StrLit strng), .Litv (.IntLit off), .Litv (.IntLit len)] ∧
        copy_array (explode strng, off) len none = none ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ strng off len cs, op_ = .CopyStrStr ∧
        vs = [.Litv (.StrLit strng), .Litv (.IntLit off), .Litv (.IntLit len)] ∧
        copy_array (explode strng, off) len none = some cs ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.StrLit (implode (String.mk cs))))) ∨
                   
      (∃ strng off len b dst dstoff ws, op_ = .CopyStrAw8 ∧
        vs = [.Litv (.StrLit strng), .Litv (.IntLit off), .Litv (.IntLit len),
              .Loc b dst, .Litv (.IntLit dstoff)] ∧
        store_lookup dst s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        copy_array (explode strng, off) len (some (ws_to_chars ws, dstoff)) = none ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ strng off len b dst dstoff ws cs s', op_ = .CopyStrAw8 ∧
        vs = [.Litv (.StrLit strng), .Litv (.IntLit off), .Litv (.IntLit len),
              .Loc b dst, .Litv (.IntLit dstoff)] ∧
        store_lookup dst s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        copy_array (explode strng, off) len (some (ws_to_chars ws, dstoff)) = some cs ∧
        store_assign dst (.W8array (chars_to_ws cs)) s = some s' ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Conv none [])) ∨
                   
      (∃ b src off len ws, op_ = .CopyAw8Str ∧
        vs = [.Loc b src, .Litv (.IntLit off), .Litv (.IntLit len)] ∧
        store_lookup src s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        copy_array (ws, off) len none = none ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ b src off len ws ws', op_ = .CopyAw8Str ∧
        vs = [.Loc b src, .Litv (.IntLit off), .Litv (.IntLit len)] ∧
        store_lookup src s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        copy_array (ws, off) len none = some ws' ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.StrLit (implode (String.mk (ws_to_chars ws')))))) ∨
                   
      (∃ b src off len b' dst dstoff ws ds, op_ = .CopyAw8Aw8 ∧
        vs = [.Loc b src, .Litv (.IntLit off), .Litv (.IntLit len),
              .Loc b' dst, .Litv (.IntLit dstoff)] ∧
        store_lookup src s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        store_lookup dst s = some (.W8array ds) ∧
        copy_array (ws, off) len (some (ds, dstoff)) = none ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ b src off len b' dst dstoff ws ds ws' s', op_ = .CopyAw8Aw8 ∧
        vs = [.Loc b src, .Litv (.IntLit off), .Litv (.IntLit len),
              .Loc b' dst, .Litv (.IntLit dstoff)] ∧
        store_lookup src s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        store_lookup dst s = some (.W8array ds) ∧
        copy_array (ws, off) len (some (ds, dstoff)) = some ws' ∧
        store_assign dst (.W8array ws') s = some s' ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Conv none [])) ∨
                         
      (∃ b dst str_arg bs new_bs s', op_ = .XorAw8Str_unsafe ∧
        vs = [.Loc b dst, .Litv (.StrLit str_arg)] ∧
        store_lookup dst s = some (.W8array bs) ∧
        xor_bytes ((explode str_arg).map (fun c => n2w_8 (ORD c))) bs = some new_bs ∧
        store_assign dst (.W8array new_bs) s = some s' ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Conv none [])) ∨
                
      (∃ val_ ls, op_ = .Implode ∧ vs = [val_] ∧
        v_to_char_list val_ = some ls ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.StrLit (implode (String.mk ls))))) ∨
                
      (∃ strng, op_ = .Explode ∧ vs = [.Litv (.StrLit strng)] ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧
        r = .Rval (list_to_v ((explode strng).map (fun c => .Litv (.Char c))))) ∨
               
      (∃ strng i, op_ = .Strsub ∧ vs = [.Litv (.StrLit strng), .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        i < 0 ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ strng i, op_ = .Strsub ∧ vs = [.Litv (.StrLit strng), .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ i.natAbs ≥ strlen strng ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ strng i, op_ = .Strsub ∧ vs = [.Litv (.StrLit strng), .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ ¬ i.natAbs ≥ strlen strng ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.Char (EL i.natAbs (explode strng))))) ∨
               
      (∃ strng, op_ = .Strlen ∧ vs = [.Litv (.StrLit strng)] ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.IntLit (Int.ofNat (strlen strng))))) ∨
               
      (∃ val_ vs' strng, op_ = .Strcat ∧ vs = [val_] ∧
        v_to_list val_ = some vs' ∧
        vs_to_string vs' = some strng ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.StrLit strng))) ∨
                  
      (∃ val_ vs', op_ = .VfromList ∧ vs = [val_] ∧
        v_to_list val_ = some vs' ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Vectorv vs')) ∨
                    
      (∃ vs' i, op_ = .Vsub_unsafe ∧ vs = [.Vectorv vs', .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        (0 ≤ i ∧ i.natAbs < vs'.length) ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (EL i.natAbs vs')) ∨
             
      (∃ vs' i, op_ = .Vsub ∧ vs = [.Vectorv vs', .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        i < 0 ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ vs' i, op_ = .Vsub ∧ vs = [.Vectorv vs', .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ i.natAbs ≥ vs'.length ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ vs' i, op_ = .Vsub ∧ vs = [.Vectorv vs', .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ ¬ i.natAbs ≥ vs'.length ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (EL i.natAbs vs')) ∨
                
      (∃ vs', op_ = .Vlength ∧ vs = [.Vectorv vs'] ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.IntLit (Int.ofNat vs'.length)))) ∨
               
      (∃ n val_, op_ = .Aalloc ∧ vs = [.Litv (.IntLit n), val_] ∧
        n < 0 ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ n val_ s' lnum, op_ = .Aalloc ∧ vs = [.Litv (.IntLit n), val_] ∧
        ¬ n < 0 ∧
        store_alloc (.Varray (REPLICATE n.natAbs val_)) s = (s', lnum) ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Loc true lnum)) ∨
                    
      (∃ s' lnum, op_ = .AallocEmpty ∧ vs = [.Conv none []] ∧
        store_alloc (.Varray []) s = (s', lnum) ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Loc true lnum)) ∨
                                        
      (∃ s' lnum, op_ = .AallocFixed ∧
        store_alloc (.Varray vs) s = (s', lnum) ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Loc true lnum)) ∨
             
      (∃ b lnum i vs', op_ = .Asub ∧ vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.Varray vs') ∧
        i < 0 ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ b lnum i vs', op_ = .Asub ∧ vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.Varray vs') ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ i.natAbs ≥ vs'.length ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ b lnum i vs', op_ = .Asub ∧ vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.Varray vs') ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ ¬ i.natAbs ≥ vs'.length ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (EL i.natAbs vs')) ∨
                    
      (∃ b lnum i vs', op_ = .Asub_unsafe ∧ vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i)] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.Varray vs') ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ ¬ i.natAbs ≥ vs'.length ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (EL i.natAbs vs')) ∨
                
      (∃ b n ws, op_ = .Alength ∧ vs = [.Loc b n] ∧
        store_lookup n s = some (.Varray ws) ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Litv (.IntLit (Int.ofNat ws.length)))) ∨
                
      (∃ b lnum i val_ vs', op_ = .Aupdate ∧
        vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i), val_] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.Varray vs') ∧
        i < 0 ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ b lnum i val_ vs', op_ = .Aupdate ∧
        vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i), val_] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.Varray vs') ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ i.natAbs ≥ vs'.length ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise sub_exn_v)) ∨
      (∃ b lnum i val_ vs' s', op_ = .Aupdate ∧
        vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i), val_] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.Varray vs') ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ ¬ i.natAbs ≥ vs'.length ∧
        store_assign lnum (.Varray (LUPDATE val_ i.natAbs vs')) s = some s' ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Conv none [])) ∨
                       
      (∃ b lnum i val_ vs' s', op_ = .Aupdate_unsafe ∧
        vs = [.Loc b lnum, .Litv (.IntLit i), val_] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.Varray vs') ∧
        ¬ i < 0 ∧ ¬ i.natAbs ≥ vs'.length ∧
        store_assign lnum (.Varray (LUPDATE val_ i.natAbs vs')) s = some s' ∧
        st' = (s', t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Conv none [])) ∨
                 
      (∃ i j, op_ = .ConfigGC ∧ vs = [.Litv (.IntLit i), .Litv (.IntLit j)] ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Conv none [])) ∨
            
      (∃ n conf b lnum ws t' ws' s', op_ = .FFI n ∧
        vs = [.Litv (.StrLit conf), .Loc b lnum] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        call_FFI t (.ExtCall n) ((explode conf).map (fun c => n2w_8 (ORD c))) ws =
          .FFI_return t' ws' ∧
        store_assign lnum (.W8array ws') s = some s' ∧
        st' = (s', t') ∧ r = .Rval (.Conv none [])) ∨
      (∃ n conf b lnum ws outcome, op_ = .FFI n ∧
        vs = [.Litv (.StrLit conf), .Loc b lnum] ∧
        store_lookup lnum s = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        call_FFI t (.ExtCall n) ((explode conf).map (fun c => n2w_8 (ORD c))) ws =
          .FFI_final outcome ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rabort (.Rffi_error outcome))) ∨
               
      (∃ env gen id_, op_ = .Env_id ∧ vs = [.Env env (gen, id_)] ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Conv none [nat_to_v gen, nat_to_v id_])) ∨
      (∃ gen id_, op_ = .Env_id ∧ vs = [.Conv none [gen, id_]] ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (.Conv none [gen, id_])) ∨
                                                               
      (∃ th_op, op_ = .ThunkOp th_op ∧
        thunk_op_fun (s, t) th_op vs = some (st', r)) ∨
                                  
      (∃ a ty res, op_ = .Arith a ty ∧
        EVERY (check_type ty) vs = true ∧
        do_arith a ty vs = some (.inr res) ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval res) ∨
      (∃ a ty exn, op_ = .Arith a ty ∧
        EVERY (check_type ty) vs = true ∧
        do_arith a ty vs = some (.inl exn) ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise exn)) ∨
               
      (∃ ty1 ty2 val_ res, op_ = .FromTo ty1 ty2 ∧ vs = [val_] ∧
        check_type ty1 val_ = true ∧
        do_conversion val_ ty1 ty2 = some (.inr res) ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval res) ∨
      (∃ ty1 ty2 val_ exn, op_ = .FromTo ty1 ty2 ∧ vs = [val_] ∧
        check_type ty1 val_ = true ∧
        do_conversion val_ ty1 ty2 = some (.inl exn) ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rerr (.Rraise exn)) ∨
             
      (∃ test_ test_ty v1 v2 b, op_ = .Test test_ test_ty ∧ vs = [v1, v2] ∧
        do_test test_ test_ty v1 v2 = .Eq_val b ∧
        st' = (s, t) ∧ r = .Rval (Boolv b)))

theorems.name: prim_canonical_values_thm
theorems.statement:
theorem prim_canonical_values_thm :
    ∀ (tvs : Nat) (ctMap_ : ctMap) (tenvS : tenv_store) (val_ : v)
      (envS : List (store_v v)) (ts : List sem_t) (t1 t2 t : sem_t),
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tint ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ →
      ∃ (n : Int), val_ = .Litv (.IntLit n)) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tchar ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ →
      ∃ (c : Char), val_ = .Litv (.Char c)) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tstring ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ →
      ∃ (s : mlstring), val_ = .Litv (.StrLit s)) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tword8 ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ →
      ∃ (n : word8), val_ = .Litv (.Word8 n)) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tword64 ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ →
      ∃ (n : word64), val_ = .Litv (.Word64 n)) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tdouble ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ →
      ∃ (n : word64), val_ = .Litv (.Float64 n)) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (Ttup ts) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ →
      ∃ (vs : List v), val_ = .Conv none vs ∧ ts.length = vs.length) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (Tfn t1 t2) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ →
      (∃ (env : sem_env) (n : varN) (e : exp), val_ = .Closure env n e) ∨
      (∃ (env : sem_env) (funs : List (varN × varN × exp)) (n : varN),
        val_ = .Recclosure env funs n)) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (Tref t1) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧ type_s ctMap_ envS tenvS →
      ∃ (n : Nat) (v2 : v),
        val_ = .Loc true n ∧ store_lookup n envS = some (.Refv v2) ∧
        type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS v2 t1) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tword8array ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧ type_s ctMap_ envS tenvS →
      ∃ (n : Nat) (ws : List word8),
        val_ = .Loc true n ∧ store_lookup n envS = some (.W8array ws) ∧
        Finmap.FLOOKUP tenvS n = some .W8array_t) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (Tarray t) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧ type_s ctMap_ envS tenvS →
      ∃ (n : Nat) (vs : List v),
        val_ = .Loc true n ∧ store_lookup n envS = some (.Varray vs) ∧
        (∀ (v_ : v), v_ ∈ vs → type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS v_ t) ∧
        Finmap.FLOOKUP tenvS n = some (.Varray_t t)) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (Tvector t) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ →
      ∃ (vs : List v),
        val_ = .Vectorv vs ∧ (∀ (v_ : v), v_ ∈ vs → type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS v_ t))

theorems.name: ctor_canonical_values_thm
theorems.statement:
theorem ctor_canonical_values_thm :
    ∀ (tvs : Nat) (ctMap_ : ctMap) (tenvS : tenv_store) (val_ : v)
      (t : sem_t) (ts : List sem_t) (ti : type_ident)
      (stmp : stamp) (tvs' : List tvarN) (ts' : List sem_t),
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tbool ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧ ctMap_has_bools ctMap_ →
      ∃ (b : Bool), val_ = Boolv b) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (Tlist t) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧ ctMap_has_lists ctMap_ →
      ∃ (vs : List v),
        v_to_list val_ = some vs ∧
        (∀ (v_ : v), v_ ∈ vs → type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS v_ t) ∧
        (t = Tchar → ∃ (vs' : List Char), v_to_char_list val_ = some vs') ∧
        (t = Tstring → ∃ (str : mlstring), vs_to_string vs = some str)) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (.Tapp ts ti) ∧
     ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧
     Finmap.FLOOKUP ctMap_ stmp = some (tvs', ts', ti) →
      (∃ (cn : conN) (n : Nat) (vs : List v),
        same_type stmp (.TypeStamp cn n) ∧ val_ = .Conv (some (.TypeStamp cn n)) vs) ∨
      (∃ (n : Nat) (vs : List v),

theorems.name: op_type_sound
theorems.statement:
theorem op_type_sound :
    ∀ {ffi : Type} (ctMap_ : ctMap) (tenvS : tenv_store) (vs : List v)
      (op_ : op) (ts : List sem_t) (t : sem_t) (store_ : List (store_v v))
      (ffi_ : ffi_state ffi),
      good_ctMap ctMap_ ∧
      op_ ≠ .Opapp ∧
      type_s ctMap_ store_ tenvS ∧
      type_op op_ ts t ∧
      check_freevars 0 [] t ∧
      LIST_REL (type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS) vs ts.reverse →
      ∃ (tenvS' : tenv_store) (store' : List (store_v v)) (ffi' : ffi_state ffi)
        (r : result v v),
        store_type_extension tenvS tenvS' ∧
        type_s ctMap_ store' tenvS' ∧
        do_app (store_, ffi_) op_ vs.reverse = some ((store', ffi'), r) ∧
        match r with
        | .Rval val_ => type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS' val_ t
        | .Rerr (.Rraise val_) => type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS' val_ Texn
        | .Rerr (.Rabort (.Rffi_error _)) => True
        | .Rerr (.Rabort _) => False

theorems.name: build_conv_type_sound
theorems.statement:
theorem build_conv_type_sound :
    ∀ (envC : env_ctor) (cn : cml_id modN conN) (vs : List v) (tvs : Nat)
      (ts : List sem_t) (ctMap_ : ctMap) (tenvS : tenv_store) (ts' : List sem_t)
      (tn : type_ident) (tenvC : tenv_ctor) (tvs' : List tvarN)
      (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (l : Nat),
      nsAll2 (type_ctor ctMap_) envC tenvC ∧
      do_con_check envC (some cn) l ∧
      num_tvs tenvE = 0 ∧
      EVERY (check_freevars (num_tvs (bind_tvar tvs tenvE)) []) ts' ∧
      tvs'.length = ts'.length ∧
      LIST_REL (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS) vs
        (ts.map (type_subst (Finmap.alist_to_fmap (tvs'.zip ts')))).reverse ∧
      nsLookup tenvC cn = some (tvs', ts, tn) →
      ∃ (val_ : v),
        build_conv envC (some cn) vs.reverse = some val_ ∧
        type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (.Tapp ts' tn)

theorems.name: pat_type_sound
theorems.statement:
theorem pat_type_sound :
    (∀ (cenv : env_ctor) (st : store v) (p : pat) (val_ : v)
       (bindings : List (varN × v)) (tenv : type_env) (ctMap_ : ctMap)
       (tbindings : List (varN × sem_t)) (t : sem_t)
       (new_tbindings : List (varN × sem_t)) (tenvS : tenv_store) (tvs : Nat),
      ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧
      nsAll2 (type_ctor ctMap_) cenv tenv.c ∧
      type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ t ∧
      type_p tvs tenv p t new_tbindings ∧
      type_s ctMap_ st tenvS ∧
      LIST_REL (fun (p1 : varN × v) (p2 : varN × sem_t) =>
        p1.1 = p2.1 ∧ type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS p1.2 p2.2) bindings tbindings →
      pmatch cenv st p val_ bindings = .No_match ∨
      ∃ (bindings' : List (varN × v)),
        pmatch cenv st p val_ bindings = .Match bindings' ∧
        LIST_REL (fun (p1 : varN × v) (p2 : varN × sem_t) =>
          p1.1 = p2.1 ∧ type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS p1.2 p2.2) bindings'
          (new_tbindings ++ tbindings)) ∧
    (∀ (cenv : env_ctor) (st : store v) (ps : List pat) (vs : List v)
       (bindings : List (varN × v)) (tenv : type_env) (ctMap_ : ctMap)
       (tbindings : List (varN × sem_t)) (new_tbindings : List (varN × sem_t))
       (ts : List sem_t) (tenvS : tenv_store) (tvs : Nat),
      ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧
      nsAll2 (type_ctor ctMap_) cenv tenv.c ∧
      LIST_REL (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS) vs ts ∧
      type_ps tvs tenv ps ts new_tbindings ∧
      type_s ctMap_ st tenvS ∧
      LIST_REL (fun (p1 : varN × v) (p2 : varN × sem_t) =>
        p1.1 = p2.1 ∧ type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS p1.2 p2.2) bindings tbindings →
      pmatch_list cenv st ps vs bindings = .No_match ∨
      ∃ (bindings' : List (varN × v)),
        pmatch_list cenv st ps vs bindings = .Match bindings' ∧
        LIST_REL (fun (p1 : varN × v) (p2 : varN × sem_t) =>
          p1.1 = p2.1 ∧ type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS p1.2 p2.2) bindings'
          (new_tbindings ++ tbindings))

theorems.name: exp_type_sound
theorems.statement:
theorem exp_type_sound :
    ∀ (ctMap_ : ctMap),
    (∀ {ffi : Type} (s : cml_state ffi) (env : sem_env) (es : List exp)
       (r : result (List v) v) (s' : cml_state ffi) (tenv : type_env)
       (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (ts : List sem_t) (tvs : Nat) (tenvS : tenv_store),
      evaluate s env es = (s', r) ∧
      tenv_ok tenv ∧
      tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
      good_ctMap ctMap_ ∧
      num_tvs tenvE = 0 ∧
      type_all_env ctMap_ tenvS env { tenv with v := add_tenvE tenvE tenv.v } ∧
      type_s ctMap_ s.refs tenvS ∧
      (tvs ≠ 0 → EVERY is_value es) ∧
      type_es tenv (bind_tvar tvs tenvE) es ts →
      ∃ (tenvS' : tenv_store),
        type_s ctMap_ s'.refs tenvS' ∧
        store_type_extension tenvS tenvS' ∧
        s'.next_type_stamp = s.next_type_stamp ∧
        s'.next_exn_stamp = s.next_exn_stamp ∧
        match r with
        | .Rval vs => LIST_REL (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS') vs ts
        | .Rerr (.Rraise val_) => type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS' val_ Texn
        | .Rerr (.Rabort .Rtimeout_error) => True
        | .Rerr (.Rabort (.Rffi_error _)) => True
        | .Rerr (.Rabort .Rtype_error) => False) ∧
    (∀ {ffi : Type} (s : cml_state ffi) (env : sem_env) (val_ : v)
       (pes : List (pat × exp)) (err_v : v) (r : result (List v) v)
       (s' : cml_state ffi) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp)
       (t1 t2 : sem_t) (tvs : Nat) (tenvS : tenv_store),
      evaluate_match s env val_ pes err_v = (s', r) ∧
      tenv_ok tenv ∧
      tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
      good_ctMap ctMap_ ∧
      num_tvs tenvE = 0 ∧
      type_all_env ctMap_ tenvS env { tenv with v := add_tenvE tenvE tenv.v } ∧
      type_s ctMap_ s.refs tenvS ∧
      type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ t1 ∧
      type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS err_v Texn ∧
      type_pes tvs tvs tenv tenvE pes t1 t2 →
      ∃ (tenvS' : tenv_store),
        type_s ctMap_ s'.refs tenvS' ∧
        store_type_extension tenvS tenvS' ∧
        s'.next_type_stamp = s.next_type_stamp ∧
        s'.next_exn_stamp = s.next_exn_stamp ∧
        match r with
        | .Rval vs => type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS' vs.head! t2
        | .Rerr (.Rraise val_) => type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS' val_ Texn
        | .Rerr (.Rabort .Rtimeout_error) => True
        | .Rerr (.Rabort (.Rffi_error _)) => True
        | .Rerr (.Rabort .Rtype_error) => False)

theorems.name: type_e_con_check

theorem type_e_con_check :
    ∀ (ctMap_ : ctMap) (envc : env_ctor),
    (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (e : exp) (t : sem_t),
      type_e tenv tenvE e t →

      every_exp (one_con_check envc) e) ∧
    (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (es : List exp) (ts : List sem_t),
      type_es tenv tenvE es ts →
      nsAll2 (type_ctor ctMap_) envc tenv.c →

    (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (funs : List (varN × varN × exp))
       (env_ : List (varN × sem_t)),
      type_funs tenv tenvE funs env_ →
      nsAll2 (type_ctor ctMap_) envc tenv.c →
      EVERY (fun (p : varN × varN × exp) => every_exp (one_con_check envc) p.2.2) funs)

theorems.name: decs_type_sound_no_check
theorems.statement:
theorem decs_type_sound_no_check :
    ∀ {ffi : Type} (st : cml_state ffi) (env : sem_env) (ds : List dec)
      (st' : cml_state ffi) (r : result sem_env v) (ctMap_ : ctMap)
      (tenvS : tenv_store) (tenv : type_env) (tids : Set type_ident)
      (tenv' : type_env),
      evaluate_decs st env ds = (st', r) ∧
      type_ds false tenv ds tids tenv' ∧
      type_sound_invariant st env ctMap_ tenvS tids tenv →
      ∃ (ctMap' : ctMap) (tenvS' : tenv_store),
        weakCT ctMap' ctMap_ ∧
        Finmap.FRANGE (Finmap.o_f (fun p => p.2.2) ctMap') \
          Finmap.FRANGE (Finmap.o_f (fun p => p.2.2) ctMap_) ⊆ tids ∧
        store_type_extension tenvS tenvS' ∧
        match r with
        | .Rval env' =>
          type_all_env ctMap' tenvS' env' tenv' ∧
          type_sound_invariant st' (extend_dec_env env' env)
            ctMap' tenvS' ∅ (extend_dec_tenv tenv' tenv)
        | .Rerr (.Rraise err_v) =>
          type_v 0 ctMap' tenvS' err_v Texn ∧
          type_sound_invariant st' env ctMap' tenvS' ∅ tenv
        | .Rerr (.Rabort .Rtype_error) => False
        | .Rerr (.Rabort .Rtimeout_error) => True
        | .Rerr (.Rabort (.Rffi_error _)) => True

theorems.name: decs_type_sound
theorems.statement:
theorem decs_type_sound :
    ∀ {ffi : Type} (st : cml_state ffi) (env : sem_env) (ds : List dec)
      (extra_checks : Bool) (st' : cml_state ffi) (r : result sem_env v)
      (ctMap_ : ctMap) (tenvS : tenv_store) (tenv : type_env) (tids : Set type_ident)
      (tenv' : type_env),
      evaluate_decs st env ds = (st', r) ∧
      type_ds extra_checks tenv ds tids tenv' ∧
      type_sound_invariant st env ctMap_ tenvS tids tenv →
      ∃ (ctMap' : ctMap) (tenvS' : tenv_store),
        weakCT ctMap' ctMap_ ∧
        Finmap.FRANGE (Finmap.o_f (fun p => p.2.2) ctMap') \
          Finmap.FRANGE (Finmap.o_f (fun p => p.2.2) ctMap_) ⊆ tids ∧
        store_type_extension tenvS tenvS' ∧
        match r with
        | .Rval env' =>
          type_all_env ctMap' tenvS' env' tenv' ∧
          type_sound_invariant st' (extend_dec_env env' env)
            ctMap' tenvS' ∅ (extend_dec_tenv tenv' tenv)
        | .Rerr (.Rraise err_v) =>
          type_v 0 ctMap' tenvS' err_v Texn ∧
          type_sound_invariant st' env ctMap' tenvS' ∅ tenv
        | .Rerr (.Rabort .Rtype_error) => False
        | .Rerr (.Rabort (.Rffi_error _)) => True
        | .Rerr (.Rabort .Rtimeout_error) => True

theorems.name: type_subst_deBruijn_inc_single

      tvs.length = ts.length ∧

      check_freevars 0 tvs t →
      deBruijn_inc sk inc (type_subst s t) =
      type_subst (Finmap.alist_to_fmap (ZIP (tvs, ts.map (fun t => deBruijn_inc sk inc t)))) t

theorems.name: type_subst_deBruijn_subst_single
theorems.statement:
theorem type_subst_deBruijn_subst_single :
    ∀ (s : Finmap tvarN sem_t) (t : sem_t) (tvs : List tvarN) (tvs' : List tvarN)

      tvs.length = ts.length ∧
      check_freevars 0 tvs t ∧
      s = Finmap.alist_to_fmap (ZIP (tvs, ts)) →
      deBruijn_subst inc ts' (type_subst (Finmap.alist_to_fmap (ZIP (tvs, ts))) t) =
      type_subst (Finmap.alist_to_fmap (ZIP (tvs, ts.map (fun t => deBruijn_subst inc ts' t)))) t

theorems.name: type_subst_deBruijn_subst_list

theorem type_subst_deBruijn_subst_list :

      tvs.length = ts.length ∧
      EVERY (check_freevars 0 tvs) ts'' →

theorems.name: deBruijn_subst2_thm
theorems.statement:
theorem deBruijn_subst2_thm :
    (∀ (t : sem_t) (sk : Nat) (targs targs' : List sem_t) (tvs' : List tvarN),

      deBruijn_subst sk (targs'.map (deBruijn_inc 0 sk)) (deBruijn_subst 0 targs t) =
      deBruijn_subst 0 (targs.map (deBruijn_subst sk (targs'.map (deBruijn_inc 0 sk)))) t) ∧
    (∀ (ts : List sem_t) (sk : Nat) (targs targs' : List sem_t) (tvs' : List tvarN),
      EVERY (check_freevars targs.length []) ts →
      (ts.map (deBruijn_subst 0 targs)).map (deBruijn_subst sk (targs'.map (deBruijn_inc 0 sk))) =
      ts.map (deBruijn_subst 0 (targs.map (deBruijn_subst sk (targs'.map (deBruijn_inc 0 sk))))))

theorems.name: type_e_subst_lem3

        tvs = n + targs.length ∧
        EVERY (check_freevars tvs' tvs2) targs →

theorems.name: type_e_subst_lem5

      deBruijn_subst (n + inc + n') (targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (n + inc + n')))
        (deBruijn_inc n inc t)) ∧
    (∀ (ts : List sem_t) (n inc n' : Nat) (targs : List sem_t),
      (ts.map (deBruijn_subst (n + n') (targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (n + n'))))).map (deBruijn_inc n inc) =
      (ts.map (deBruijn_inc n inc)).map (deBruijn_subst (n + inc + n') (targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (n + inc + n')))))

theorems.name: subst_inc_cancel

theorems.name: type_e_subst_lem7

    (∀ (t : sem_t) (sk : Nat) (targs targs' : List sem_t) (tvs' tvs'' : List tvarN),

    (∀ (ts : List sem_t) (sk : Nat) (targs targs' : List sem_t) (tvs' tvs'' : List tvarN),
      (ts.map (deBruijn_subst 0 targs)).map (deBruijn_subst sk (targs'.map (deBruijn_inc 0 sk))) =

theorems.name: type_op_cases_thm
theorems.statement:
theorem type_op_cases_thm :
    ∀ (op_ : op) (ts : List sem_t) (t3 : sem_t),
      type_op op_ ts t3 ↔
        (∃ u1 u2, op_ = .Opapp ∧ ts = [u1, u2] ∧ u1 = Tfn u2 t3) ∨
        (∃ sh n u1, op_ = .Shift .W8 sh n ∧ ts = [u1] ∧ u1 = Tword8 ∧ t3 = Tword8) ∨
        (∃ sh n u1, op_ = .Shift .W64 sh n ∧ ts = [u1] ∧ u1 = Tword64 ∧ t3 = Tword64) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2, op_ = .Equality ∧ ts = [u1, u2] ∧ u1 = u2 ∧ t3 = Tbool) ∨
        (∃ a ty, op_ = .Arith a ty ∧ (∀ arg, arg ∈ ts → arg = t_of ty) ∧ t3 = t_of ty ∧
          supported_arith a ty = some ts.length) ∨
        (∃ ty1 ty2 u1, op_ = .FromTo ty1 ty2 ∧ ts = [u1] ∧ u1 = t_of ty1 ∧ t3 = t_of ty2 ∧
          supported_conversion ty1 ty2 = true) ∨
        (∃ tst ty u1 u2, op_ = .Test tst ty ∧ ts = [u1, u2] ∧ u1 = u2 ∧ t3 = Tbool ∧
          u1 = t_of ty ∧ supported_test tst ty = true) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2, op_ = .Opassign ∧ ts = [u1, u2] ∧ u1 = Tref u2 ∧ t3 = Ttup []) ∨
        (∃ u1, op_ = .Opref ∧ ts = [u1] ∧ t3 = Tref u1) ∨
        (∃ u1, op_ = .Opderef ∧ ts = [u1] ∧ u1 = Tref t3) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2, op_ = .Aw8alloc ∧ ts = [u1, u2] ∧ u1 = Tint ∧ u2 = Tword8 ∧ t3 = Tword8array) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2, op_ = .Aw8sub ∧ ts = [u1, u2] ∧ u1 = Tword8array ∧ u2 = Tint ∧ t3 = Tword8) ∨
        (∃ u1, op_ = .Aw8length ∧ ts = [u1] ∧ u1 = Tword8array ∧ t3 = Tint) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2 u3, op_ = .Aw8update ∧ ts = [u1, u2, u3] ∧ u1 = Tword8array ∧ u2 = Tint ∧
          u3 = Tword8 ∧ t3 = Ttup []) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2 u3, op_ = .CopyStrStr ∧ ts = [u1, u2, u3] ∧ u1 = Tstring ∧ u2 = Tint ∧
          u3 = Tint ∧ t3 = Tstring) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2 u3 u4 u5, op_ = .CopyStrAw8 ∧ ts = [u1, u2, u3, u4, u5] ∧ u1 = Tstring ∧
          u2 = Tint ∧ u3 = Tint ∧ u4 = Tword8array ∧ u5 = Tint ∧ t3 = Ttup []) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2 u3, op_ = .CopyAw8Str ∧ ts = [u1, u2, u3] ∧ u1 = Tword8array ∧ u2 = Tint ∧
          u3 = Tint ∧ t3 = Tstring) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2 u3 u4 u5, op_ = .CopyAw8Aw8 ∧ ts = [u1, u2, u3, u4, u5] ∧ u1 = Tword8array ∧
          u2 = Tint ∧ u3 = Tint ∧ u4 = Tword8array ∧ u5 = Tint ∧ t3 = Ttup []) ∨
        (∃ u1, op_ = .Implode ∧ ts = [u1] ∧ u1 = Tlist Tchar ∧ t3 = Tstring) ∨
        (∃ u1, op_ = .Explode ∧ ts = [u1] ∧ u1 = Tstring ∧ t3 = Tlist Tchar) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2, op_ = .Strsub ∧ ts = [u1, u2] ∧ u1 = Tstring ∧ u2 = Tint ∧ t3 = Tchar) ∨
        (∃ u1, op_ = .Strlen ∧ ts = [u1] ∧ u1 = Tstring ∧ t3 = Tint) ∨
        (∃ u1, op_ = .Strcat ∧ ts = [u1] ∧ u1 = Tlist Tstring ∧ t3 = Tstring) ∨
        (∃ u1 ctor, op_ = .VfromList ∧ ts = [.Tapp [u1] ctor] ∧ ctor = Tlist_num ∧
          t3 = Tvector u1) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2, op_ = .Vsub ∧ ts = [u1, u2] ∧ u2 = Tint ∧ Tvector t3 = u1) ∨
        (∃ u1 ctor, op_ = .Vlength ∧ ts = [.Tapp [u1] ctor] ∧ ctor = Tvector_num ∧ t3 = Tint) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2, op_ = .Aalloc ∧ ts = [u1, u2] ∧ u1 = Tint ∧ t3 = Tarray u2) ∨
        (∃ u1, op_ = .AallocEmpty ∧ ts = [u1] ∧ u1 = Ttup [] ∧ ∃ u2, t3 = Tarray u2) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2, op_ = .Asub ∧ ts = [u1, u2] ∧ u2 = Tint ∧ Tarray t3 = u1) ∨
        (∃ u1 ctor, op_ = .Alength ∧ ts = [.Tapp [u1] ctor] ∧ ctor = Tarray_num ∧ t3 = Tint) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2 u3, op_ = .Aupdate ∧ ts = [u1, u2, u3] ∧ u1 = Tarray u3 ∧ u2 = Tint ∧
          t3 = Ttup []) ∨
        (∃ u1 u2, op_ = .ConfigGC ∧ ts = [u1, u2] ∧ u1 = Tint ∧ u2 = Tint ∧ t3 = Ttup []) ∨
        (∃ nm u1 u2, op_ = .FFI nm ∧ ts = [u1, u2] ∧ u1 = Tstring ∧ u2 = Tword8array ∧
          t3 = Ttup []) ∨
        (∃ u1 ctor u2, op_ = .ListAppend ∧ ts = [.Tapp [u1] ctor, u2] ∧ ctor = Tlist_num ∧
          u2 = sem_t.Tapp [u1] ctor ∧ t3 = u2)

theorems.name: type_p_subst
theorems.statement:
theorem type_p_subst :
    (∀ (n : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (p : pat) (t : sem_t) (new_bindings : List (varN × sem_t)),
      type_p n tenv p t new_bindings →
      ∀ (targs' : List sem_t) (inc : Nat) (tvs : Nat) (targs : List sem_t),
        tenv_abbrev_ok tenv.t ∧
        tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
        n = inc + targs.length ∧
        EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs ∧
        targs' = targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 inc) →
        type_p (inc + tvs) tenv p
          (deBruijn_subst inc targs' t)
          (new_bindings.map (fun (x, t) => (x, deBruijn_subst inc targs' t)))) ∧
    (∀ (n : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (ps : List pat) (ts : List sem_t) (new_bindings : List (varN × sem_t)),
      type_ps n tenv ps ts new_bindings →
      ∀ (targs' : List sem_t) (inc : Nat) (targs : List sem_t) (tvs : Nat),
        tenv_abbrev_ok tenv.t ∧
        tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
        n = inc + targs.length ∧
        EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs ∧
        targs' = targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 inc) →
        type_ps (inc + tvs) tenv ps
          (ts.map (deBruijn_subst inc targs'))
          (new_bindings.map (fun (x, t) => (x, deBruijn_subst inc targs' t))))

theorems.name: type_p_bvl
theorems.statement:
theorem type_p_bvl :
    (∀ (tvs : Nat) (tenvC : type_env) (p : pat) (t : sem_t) (bindings : List (varN × sem_t)),
      type_p tvs tenvC p t bindings →
      ∀ (tenv' : tenv_val_exp), tenv_val_exp_ok tenv' → tenv_val_exp_ok (bind_var_list tvs bindings tenv')) ∧
    (∀ (tvs : Nat) (tenvC : type_env) (ps : List pat) (ts : List sem_t) (bindings : List (varN × sem_t)),
      type_ps tvs tenvC ps ts bindings →
      ∀ (tenv' : tenv_val_exp), tenv_val_exp_ok tenv' → tenv_val_exp_ok (bind_var_list tvs bindings tenv'))

theorems.name: type_p_tenvV_indep

theorem type_p_tenvV_indep :

      type_p tvs tenv p t bindings = type_p tvs { tenv with v := tenvV } p t bindings) ∧

theorems.name: type_es_length

theorems.name: tenv_val_exp_ok_bvl_funs

theorems.name: type_e_freevars
theorems.statement:
theorem type_e_freevars :
    (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (e : exp) (t : sem_t),
      type_e tenv tenvE e t →
      tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧ tenv_val_ok tenv.v →
      check_freevars (num_tvs tenvE) [] t) ∧
    (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (es : List exp) (ts : List sem_t),
      type_es tenv tenvE es ts →
      tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧ tenv_val_ok tenv.v →
      EVERY (check_freevars (num_tvs tenvE) []) ts) ∧
    (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (funs : List (varN × varN × exp))
       (env : List (varN × sem_t)),
      type_funs tenv tenvE funs env →
      tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧ tenv_val_ok tenv.v →
      EVERY (check_freevars (num_tvs tenvE) []) (env.map Prod.snd))

theorems.name: type_e_subst
theorems.statement:
theorem type_e_subst :
    ∀ (tenvE2 : tenv_val_exp),
    (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (e : exp) (t : sem_t),
      type_e tenv tenvE e t →
      ∀ (tenvE1 : tenv_val_exp) (targs : List sem_t) (tvs : Nat) (targs' : List sem_t),
        num_tvs tenvE2 = 0 ∧
        tenv_abbrev_ok tenv.t ∧
        tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
        tenv_val_ok tenv.v ∧
        tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
        EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs ∧
        tenvE = db_merge tenvE1 (bind_tvar targs.length tenvE2) ∧
        targs' = targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (num_tvs tenvE1)) →
        type_e tenv (db_merge (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs tenvE1) (bind_tvar tvs tenvE2))
          e (deBruijn_subst (num_tvs tenvE1) targs' t)) ∧
    (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (es : List exp) (ts : List sem_t),
      type_es tenv tenvE es ts →
      ∀ (tenvE1 : tenv_val_exp) (targs : List sem_t) (tvs : Nat) (targs' : List sem_t),
        num_tvs tenvE2 = 0 ∧
        tenv_abbrev_ok tenv.t ∧
        tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
        tenv_val_ok tenv.v ∧
        tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
        EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs ∧
        tenvE = db_merge tenvE1 (bind_tvar targs.length tenvE2) ∧
        targs' = targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (num_tvs tenvE1)) →
        type_es tenv (db_merge (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs tenvE1) (bind_tvar tvs tenvE2))
          es (ts.map (deBruijn_subst (num_tvs tenvE1) targs'))) ∧
    (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (funs : List (varN × varN × exp))
       (env : List (varN × sem_t)),
      type_funs tenv tenvE funs env →
      ∀ (tenvE1 : tenv_val_exp) (targs : List sem_t) (tvs : Nat) (targs' : List sem_t),
        num_tvs tenvE2 = 0 ∧
        tenv_abbrev_ok tenv.t ∧
        tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
        tenv_val_ok tenv.v ∧
        tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
        EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs ∧
        tenvE = db_merge tenvE1 (bind_tvar targs.length tenvE2) ∧
        targs' = targs.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (num_tvs tenvE1)) →
        type_funs tenv (db_merge (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs tenvE1) (bind_tvar tvs tenvE2))
          funs (env.map (fun (x, t) => (x, deBruijn_subst (num_tvs tenvE1) targs' t))))

theorems.name: type_funs_Tfn
theorems.statement:

theorems.name: type_funs_find_recfun

theorems.name: type_recfun_lookup

theorems.name: mem_type_def_to_ctMap

theorems.name: type_def_to_ctMap_mem

theorems.name: ctMap_ok_type_defs

theorems.name: type_p_weakening
theorems.statement:
theorem type_p_weakening :
    (∀ (tvs : Nat) (tenv : type_env) (p : pat) (t : sem_t) (bindings : List (varN × sem_t)),
      type_p tvs tenv p t bindings →
      ∀ (tenv' : type_env) (tvs' : Nat),
        tvs' ≥ tvs ∧ weak tenv' tenv → type_p tvs' tenv' p t bindings) ∧
